why.before: Build attacks and range pressure, then fight behind a reliable initiator. Windburn’s extended attacks and native healing reward uninterrupted contact; Onixian Quiver and later critical damage support that plan. Use the projectile tools deliberately to preserve the attack window, not as a reason to stand in every threat.
why.after: Build attacks and range pressure, then fight behind a reliable initiator. Windburn’s extended attacks and native healing reward uninterrupted contact; Onixian Quiver supports its melee critical-chance and low-health mitigation effects; it does not grant Yin ranged extra projectiles. Use the projectile tools deliberately to preserve the attack window, not as a reason to stand in every threat.
